title: A/R Collection: Clear all filters brings everyone back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer N has nothing past due and no unused credit.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Pick customer N in the Customer chip.
  4. Read the message.
  5. Click "Clear all filters".
  6. Read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • "No record matches these filters" with a "Clear all filters" button.

Step 6:

  • every customer with past-due documents is listed again; the date is unchanged.

Why this matters: The user must never be stuck on an empty report.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/shared/filters/FilteredTableEmptyState.vue:27-36; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:13-24. V1 code, quoted: `<Button v-if="showClearAction" ...> Clear all filters`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-114) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
